name: jysharness
description: JYSHarness - a Claude-Code-style agent harness built from scratch (zero runtime deps).

scripts.demo: node src/cli/main.ts --provider mock --script examples/mock-scenario.json --workspace examples/demo-workspace -y -p "summarise this workspace"
scripts.test: node --test tests/harness.test.ts tests/server.test.ts tests/features.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/workspace.test.ts tests/session-delete.test.ts tests/plugins.test.ts tests/worktrees.test.ts
